"""End to end functional checks of the replay contract."""
import json, subprocess, sys

PY = [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '/workspace/submission/main.py']


def run(request):
    data = request if isinstance(request, (bytes, str)) else json.dumps(request)
    if isinstance(data, str):
        data = data.encode()
    proc = subprocess.run(PY, input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[:3000])
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())


def topo2():
    return {
        "nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 100},
                  {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 100}],
        "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 100}],
        "external_nodes": ["A", "B"],
    }


def settings(**kw):
    base = {"trials": 4, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 11, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0,
            "tau": 0, "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 2}
    base.update(kw)
    return base


def stream(events, topology=None, **kw):
    return {"topology": topology or topo2(), "settings": settings(**kw), "events": events}


FAILURES = []


def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILURES.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)[:1500])
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)[:1500])
    else:
        print("pass", name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- invalid json
for name, raw in [
    ("empty", b""),
    ("garbage", b"not json"),
    ("bom", b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"streams":[]}'),
    ("duplicate", b'{"streams":[],"streams":[]}'),
    ("nan", b'{"streams":NaN}'),
    ("infinity", b'{"streams":[],"x":Infinity}'),
    ("bad utf8", b'{"streams":[\xff]}'),
    ("unclosed", b'{"streams":['),
    ("huge float", b'{"streams":1e400}'),
]:
    check("invalid_json/" + name, run(raw), {"error": "invalid_json"})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- patch rules
base_patch = {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 10]], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10}}}
accepted = run({"streams": [stream([base_patch])]})
check("patch/valid", accepted["streams"][0]["events"][0], {"op": "patch", "accepted": True})

bad_patches = {
    "extra field": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {}, "label": "x"},
    "missing field": {"op": "patch", "demands": []},
    "demands type": {"op": "patch", "demands": {}, "counters": {}},
    "counters type": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": []},
    "demand arity": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1]], "counters": {}},
    "demand arity long": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 2, 3]], "counters": {}},
    "demand bool": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, True]], "counters": {}},
    "demand float": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 1.5]], "counters": {}},
    "demand repeat": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 5], [0, 1, 6]], "counters": {}},
    "demand same node": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 0, 5]], "counters": {}},
    "demand unknown node": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 9, 5]], "counters": {}},
    "demand negative": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, -1]], "counters": {}},
    "demand too large": {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 10**9 + 1]], "counters": {}},
    "unknown counter": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_Z_egress_to_Q": {"perturbed": 1}}},
    "counter over capacity": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 101}}},
    "counter negative": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": -1}}},
    "counter bool": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": True}}},
    "counter missing perturbed": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {}}},
    "counter extra key": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 1, "x": 2}}},
    "counter cell type": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": 5}},
    "counter cell list": {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": []}},
}
for name, patch in bad_patches.items():
    out = run({"streams": [stream([patch])]})
    check("patch/reject/" + name, out["streams"][0]["events"][0], {"op": "patch", "accepted": False})

good_cells = {
    "null cell": {"low_A_egress_to_B": None},
    "annotations": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 5, "ground_truth": {"a": 1}, "corrected": [1, 2], "confidence": "x"}},
    "null perturbed": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": None, "ground_truth": 9}},
}
for name, cell in good_cells.items():
    out = run({"streams": [stream([{"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": cell}])]})
    check("patch/accept/" + name, out["streams"][0]["events"][0], {"op": "patch", "accepted": True})

# non external node demand
topo3 = {
    "nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 100},
              {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 100},
              {"id": 2, "name": "C", "external_capacity": 100}],
    "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 100},
              {"source": 1, "target": 2, "capacity": 100}],
    "external_nodes": ["A", "B"],
}
out = run({"streams": [stream([{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 2, 5]], "counters": {}}], topology=topo3)]})
check("patch/reject/non external demand", out["streams"][0]["events"][0], {"op": "patch", "accepted": False})

# atomicity: a rejected patch must not change any state
events = [
    {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 10]], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10}}},
    {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 20]], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 999}}},
    {"op": "repair", "id": "r"},
]
out = run({"streams": [stream(events)]})
events_out = out["streams"][0]["events"]
check("patch/atomic accept", events_out[0], {"op": "patch", "accepted": True})
check("patch/atomic reject", events_out[1], {"op": "patch", "accepted": False})
links = {tuple(e[:2]): e for e in events_out[2]["links"]}
check("patch/atomic state", links[(0, 1)][2], 10)

print("failures:", FAILURES)
sys.exit(1 if FAILURES else 0)
PYEOF
